### Scenario support (removed, gap flagged)

The note-based Scenario Support gate (confidence caps keyed to per-theme Support class), the Scenario Support Judge, and the Trigger grounding / Prior basis enforcement they carried are deleted along with **Note state** and note-derived Support class propagation; there is no more note-derived support tier to cap confidence against. This campaign's landed-state audit did not establish what, if anything, replaces confidence-capping and trigger-grounding for scenarios and positions on the four-step contract. `analyze`'s calibration feedback loop (see **Scenario-outcomes calibration store**) still runs a k-NN prior into a Black-Litterman posterior, but that is a probability-estimation mechanism, not a confidence-capping enforcement point. Treat scenario/position confidence bounding as an open design question, not a documented current behavior.
